title: do not wash misery with tears dripped from closed eyes of missed hope Does one emotion tire a morning routine more than regrets of not wishing yesterd
summary: do not wash misery with tears dripped from closed eyes of missed hope Does one emotion tire a morning routine more than regrets of not wishing yesterday for a today that already is? #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
do not wash
  misery
with tears
  dripped from
closed eyes
    of missed hope
Does one emotion
  tire a morning routine
more
than regrets of
not wishing yesterday
  for a today that
already is?
#smallpoems
